answer: The anchor counter is kept in cipher and umber publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3841 identities would post 2257 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
